thread:
incident-bot: @oncall-page High p99 tail latency detected for canary 'model-alpha-v3' in region us-west-2. p95=680ms, p99=2.3s, SLO (p99) = 1.5s. Spike started ~+00:02. Auto-alert: routing skew + increased KV misses. Paging @abby.

abby (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Observed burst at ~+00:02 matching canary weight change. Mateo/Priya can you join for runtime + infra? I'll attach initial graphs. :eyes:

mateo (eng-runtime): joining. Quick snapshot: batching queue depth jumped from median 12 -> 86, avg tokens/sec per GPU down ~20%. KV cache miss rate up to 18% vs baseline 2.2%. See logs: repeated `kv_lock_timeout` and `streaming stall: waiting for chunk` traces. Looks like request fanout to encoder increased during traffic skew and caused backpressure.

priya (eng-sre): I'm online. Correlating with rollout ctl: canary weight went to 35% at 2494999980 per deploy-bot. Prior rollout tests had 10-20% traffic samples only. Suggest immediate mitigation: reduce canary to 0% and enable fallback variant.

deploy-bot: rollout event: canary model-alpha-v3 -> weight 35% (triggered by traffic-shift pipeline).

abby (oncall): Agreed. Executing manual weight set to 0 and enabling fallback. Running command:

```
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --deployment model-alpha --canary 0 --reason "p99 spike" --region us-west-2
redwoodctl rollout enable-fallback --deployment model-alpha --variant model-alpha-v2
```

mateo (eng-runtime): Good. Also flipping on aggressive KV warming for v2 and bumping per-request concurrency limit to limit head-of-line blocking. Will apply kernel fallback to avoid expensive quant path on v3.

priya (eng-sre): Taking traffic off canary now. Observability: throttles removed? We'll watch p99.

abby (oncall): Can confirm deployctl accepted change. New canary weight = 0 at 2495000084. Rolling window: watch p99.

(live metrics)
- 2495000090 p95 540ms p99 880ms
- 2495000140 p95 520ms p99 720ms

mateo (eng-runtime): p99 dropping, KV miss rate trending down to ~3.5%. Batching backlog draining. Streaming stall traces reduced. Looks like mitigation working.

lina (cs): CS update: monitoring for any customer error reports. So far 9 customers saw increased tail latency in last 10m, no support tickets yet. Sending advisory ping to tier-1 for possible follow-up.

jamal (product): Thanks — want a short postmortem note: was the rollout target skewed vs traffic? Do we need canary weighting safeguards?

priya (eng-sre): Preliminary root-cause hypothesis: v3's encoding path interacts poorly with our new continuous batching heuristics at intermediate sequence lengths; combined with a sudden traffic skew to canary (35%) created transient head-of-line backpressure and elevated KV misses. Two independent issues: model-specific kernel path + rollout weight spike.

mateo (eng-runtime): Repro steps (local sim): generate mixed-length traffic (50% short <64 tokens, 50% mid 256 tokens) and push 30% to v3; you'll see batching queue growth and repeated kv lock timeouts within ~60s. I'll add test harness.

abby (oncall): Next actions: 1) Priya & Mateo validate full rollback & db warming done (in progress) 2) Product to review rollout policy and add automatic guard rails 3) CS to pre-emptively notify affected customers if we see errors >2% for 30m 4) Oncall to monitor for 60m then close.

priya (eng-sre): Confirming rollback completed; fallback variant active. I'll keep an eye for any residual p99 blips and post incident notes into #postmortems after we stabilize.

mateo (eng-runtime): I'll open an RFC with perf findings and propose: a) degrade v3 kernel on particular seq-len ranges, b) add rollout circuit-breaker: if p99 > 1.5s during weight change, auto-decrease weight step.

lina (cs): CS will prep templated message: short incident summary + mitigation + ETA for fix. No outward communication needed right now until we confirm impacted accounts count.

jamal (product): Agree on the circuit-breaker. Also suggest adding a preflight perf sample step for canary >20% that runs synthetic traffic for 5m.

abby (oncall): Status update at +30m: p99 steady ~650-750ms, KV miss ~2.8%, no user-visible errors reported outside noise. I'm handing off to night oncall @priya in 20m with summary below.

--- Handoff summary (abby -> priya) ---
- Incident: canary 'model-alpha-v3' induced p99 spike via traffic skew & kernel/kv interactions.
- Timeline: spike started 2495000000, mitigation (set-weight 0) at 2495000084, p99 recovered ~2495000140.
- Current state: fallback variant (v2) active, canary off, monitoring for 60m.
- Action items: mateo to provide perf RFC; product to add rollout safeguards; cs to notify if errors persist.

priya (eng-sre): acked handoff. I'm taking ownership for the next 2h. If anything noisy happens ping me or use page. Closing note: great cross-team response — we reduced customer impact quickly. :white_check_mark:
